protocol_title: Candidate-A Validation Protocol v1.0.1 — Technical-Only Amendment
role_definition: POST-LOCK INDEPENDENT ROBUSTNESS VALIDATION (Not a generative experiment, not a new primary endpoint, not re-analysis of Study 1 or 2)
upstream_immutability_statement: Candidate-A Validation Protocol v1.0 defines a post-lock secondary robustness-validation layer on already frozen outputs only. Study 1 and Study 2 remain immutable. The N=119 cohort, target/protected roles, person-specific references, PRE images, A0/A1/A2 generated outputs, seeds [1101, 2202, 3303], structural/human correspondence records, evaluability and missingness states, Buffalo_L measurements, continuous Delta_ID = POST - PRE definition, Study-1 and Study-2 estimands, statistical models, Results Locks, Interpretation Locks, and Discussion Locks cannot be altered by V1–V3. Validation cannot reopen exclusions, generate replacement outputs, change identity correspondence, redefine PASS/FAIL, replace Buffalo_L, modify primary hypotheses, or retroactively alter any Study-1/Study-2 result.

t1_environment_provenance.approved_provenance_statement: The validation environment was prepared post-lock and is not being used to redefine the historical Study-1/2 execution environment.
t1_environment_provenance.historical_environment_statement: The historical Study-1/2 runtime environments are not reconstructed, modified, or reinterpreted by this amendment.

t2_display_staging_clarification.statement: The original v1.0 blinded packet manifest is retained as a superseded provenance artifact. Human deployment under v1.0.1 may use only the opaque staged deployment manifest. The frozen private authoritative action map, selected cases, selected seeds, packet IDs, and LEFT/RIGHT assignments remain unchanged.

primary_endpoint_invariant: Buffalo_L continuous self-identity transition remains primary and frozen. No categorical identity PASS/FAIL threshold is introduced.

V1.name: V1 — Independent Identity Evaluator
V1.population: existing 287 A1/A2 jointly measurable case*seed rows (111 contributing cases)

V2.name: V2 — Blinded Human Identity Validation
V2.seed_selection: one jointly measurable seed per case (lexicographically smallest hash)

V3.name: V3 — Nuisance and Alternative-Explanation Sensitivity Analysis
V3.scientific_characterization: NUISANCE AND ALTERNATIVE-EXPLANATION SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ONLY (Never call causal confounder adjustment, causal deconfounding, or mechanism identification)

nuisance_rules.prospective_standardization: z(D_q) = (D_q - mean(D_q)) / sd(D_q) across available paired rows
nuisance_rules.degeneracy_rule: if sd(D_q) == 0, mark DEGENERATE_INVARIANT_NUISANCE and omit from regression

models.core_protected_model: D_Buffalo_j ~ Seed + z(D_log_area) + z(D_log_sharpness) + z(D_det_confidence) + (1 | Case)
models.core_target_model: D_Buffalo_k ~ Seed + z(D_log_area) + z(D_log_sharpness) + z(D_det_confidence) + (1 | Case)
models.pose_augmented_protected_model: D_Buffalo_j ~ Seed + z(D_log_area) + z(D_log_sharpness) + z(D_det_confidence) + z(D_abs_yaw) + z(D_abs_pitch) + (1 | Case)
models.pose_augmented_target_model: D_Buffalo_k ~ Seed + z(D_log_area) + z(D_log_sharpness) + z(D_det_confidence) + z(D_abs_yaw) + z(D_abs_pitch) + (1 | Case)

V3.seed_marginalization: equal 1/3 per seed [1101, 2202, 3303] at standardized nuisance contrasts = 0

interpretation_taxonomy.direction_expected: positive A2 - A1 (consistent with locked Study-2 protected contrast)

per_axis_definitions.CONCORDANT: point_estimate > 0 AND 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
per_axis_definitions.DISCORDANT: point_estimate < 0 AND 95% bootstrap CI upper bound < 0
per_axis_definitions.INCONCLUSIVE: point_estimate <= 0 while CI includes 0, or point_estimate == 0, or analysis not estimable, or technical failure, or sparse human evidence (<3 judgeable votes)

overall_protected_primary_state.OVERALL_CONCORDANT: V1 == CONCORDANT AND V2 == CONCORDANT AND V3 == CONCORDANT
overall_protected_primary_state.OVERALL_DISCORDANT: ANY of V1, V2, V3 protected-primary axis is DISCORDANT
overall_protected_primary_state.OVERALL_PARTIALLY_CONCORDANT: NO axis is DISCORDANT AND not all three are CONCORDANT AND fewer than two axes are INCONCLUSIVE AND at least one axis is CONCORDANT or PARTIALLY_CONCORDANT
overall_protected_primary_state.OVERALL_INCONCLUSIVE: NO axis is DISCORDANT AND two or more axes are INCONCLUSIVE

interpretation_taxonomy.note: Statuses are defined for future evaluation; NO validation outcome is evaluated in this materialization task.
